menu_permission.permission_format: {module_code}/{section-slug}/{sub-section-slug}:{flag}; flag is a UserRoleDetailed column (view, add, edit, delete, approve, reject, remarks, close)

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve factory production data with summary cards (total indents, dealers, areas) and pagination.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves production data with summary metrics (total indents, distinct dealers, distinct areas). Returns paginated results with cards.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Invalid token or user not found

endpoints.short_description: Retrieve factory production data with summary cards (total indents, dealers, areas) and pagination.
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve factory production data with summary cards (total indents, dealers, areas) and pagination. It calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IFactoryProduction.GetFactoryProductionData, IFactoryProduction.GetFactoryIndentSummary. Data access uses stored procedure(s): GetFactoryProduction. Possible responses: 200, 401, 500.

error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Invalid token or user not found [when currentUser == null]
error_handling.exceptions: Caught and returned as 500 with the exception message (catches: Exception)

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to retrieve factory production data with summary cards (total indents, dealers, areas) and pagination.
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data

llm_tool_definition.name: factory_production_get_all
llm_tool_definition.description: Retrieve factory production data with summary cards (total indents, dealers, areas) and pagination.

endpoints.name: PrintAction
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve indent records for printing with consent/consolidated form flags.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves indents by IDs with product details and approval info for printing.
business_logic.preconditions: Indent IDs provided. Indents must exist.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: No current-user lookup in the controller code

validation_rules.message: No indents found for the provided IDs.

endpoints.short_description: Retrieve indent records for printing with consent/consolidated form flags.
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve indent records for printing with consent/consolidated form flags. It calls IFactoryProduction.GetIndentsByIds. Possible responses: 200, 404, 500.

error_handling.not_found: 404: No indents found for the provided IDs. [when indents == null || !indents.Any()]
error_handling.exceptions: No explicit 500 handler in controller code

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to retrieve indent records for printing with consent/consolidated form flags.
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data

llm_tool_definition.name: factory_production_print_action
llm_tool_definition.description: Retrieve indent records for printing with consent/consolidated form flags.
